IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives VanDeWege, Kessler, Blake, Dunn, and McIntire

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing sales and use tax exemptions for certain organic biomass.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing sales and use tax exemptions forcertain organic biomass; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; andadding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales oforganic biomass to a qualified business. (2) For the purposes of this section and section 2 of this act: (a) "Organic biomass" means: (i) Solid organic fuels from wood orforest residue that do not include wood pieces that have been treatedwith chemical preservatives such as creosote, pentachlorophenol, orcopperchromearsenic; or (ii) byproducts of pulping or woodmanufacturing processes, including but not limited to bark, wood chips,sawdust, and lignin in spent pulping liquors, where wood pieces werenot treated with chemical preservatives. (b) "Qualified business" means a pulp and paper mill located inWashington that uses organic biomass for the primary purpose of burning p. 1 HB 3328the biomass in a boiler to produce steam to either: (i) Generateelectricity; or (ii) be used in the pulp and paper production process;or both.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to theuse of organic biomass, if used by a qualified business. (2) The definitions in section 1 of this act apply to this section.
